entries.jp: 嵐山の公開雷舞から\n一週間が経った
entries.en:
A week had
passed since the
public live at
Arashiyama.

entries.jp:
龍馬と土方達の合奏の後
強制的に打ち切られた
雷舞だったが
entries.en:
After Ryoma's
session with
Hijikata and the
others, the live
had been forcibly
shut down, but...

entries.jp:
京の町には　あの日
新選組とやりあった
闖入者の噂が
広まっていた
entries.en:
...rumors had
spread through
Kyoto of the
intruder who had
clashed with the
Shinsengumi that
day.

entries.jp: 新選組と\n互角の歌唱力を持つ\nあの男は一体何者なのか
entries.en:
Who on earth was
that man, with
singing to rival
the
Shinsengumi's?

entries.jp: もう一度\nあの熱い歌を聴きたい
entries.en: "I want to hear\nthat blazing song\none more time."

entries.jp:
噂の闖入者と仲間達は
そんな民衆の想いに
応えるかのように
新たな行動を起こしていた
entries.en:
As if answering
the people's wish,
the rumored
intruder and his
comrades had
made a new move.

entries.jp: 薄暗い雷舞屋\n（ライブハウス）に\n熱いシャウトが木霊する
entries.en: In a dim live\nhouse, a fiery\nshout echoed.

entries.jp: その歌声とギターの音は\n黒山の人だかりを\n興奮の渦に巻き込んでいた
entries.en:
The singing and
the guitar swept
the packed crowd
into a whirlwind
of excitement.

entries.jp: みんな\nよく来てくれたな！
entries.en: Everybody,\nthanks for comin'\nout!

entries.jp: わしらの歌を聴くために\nこんなに人が集まって\nくれて感激ぜよ
entries.en:
So many folks
came to hear our
songs... I'm
touched, I tell ya!

entries.jp: みんなー\nありがとうー\n愛してるぜよォォォ
entries.en: Everybody~!\nThank youuu~! I\nlove ya allll!

entries.jp: みんな　私達の雷舞に\n来てくれてありがとう\nみんなと会えて嬉しいよ
entries.en:
Everyone, thank
you for coming to
our live! I'm so
happy to meet
you all!

entries.jp: この感動は　そう\nエレキテルと出会った時の\nそれと同じもの
entries.en:
This thrill is...
yes, the very
same one I felt
when I first met
the elekiter.

entries.jp: 明日は未来来る！\nだから　付いてきて
entries.en: Tomorrow, the\nfuture comes! So\nfollow me!

entries.jp: ハイスピードで\n駆け抜けるよ\n烈ロックンロール
entries.en:
We'll race
through at high
speed! Let's rock
'n' roll!

entries.jp:
センセーの挨拶（ＭＣ）を
聞いて女の子達が
飛び跳ねとる
センセーもやるなあ！
entries.en:
Sensei's MC-ing's
got the girls
jumpin' up and
down! Not bad,
Sensei!

entries.jp: どうもありがとう\n決めゼリフは大切ですよね
entries.en:
Thank you very
much. A good
catchphrase is
important, isn't
it?

entries.jp: うんうん\n大切ぜよ～
entries.en: Yup, yup. Real\nimportant~

entries.jp: おい　龍馬　桂さん\n余計なこと言ってねェで\n雷舞を続けるぞ
entries.en:
Hey, Ryoma,
Katsura-san. Quit
yapping about
nothing and let's
get on with the
live.

entries.jp: シンディは短気だなぁ\n雷舞は始まったばかりぜよ\nそんなに急がなくても……
entries.en:
Shindy's so
short-tempered.
The live's only
just started. No
need to rush...

entries.jp: 黙れ　バカ\n無駄口叩かずに\nさっさと準備をしろ
entries.en:
Shut it, idiot. Quit
flapping your
gums and get
ready already.

entries.jp: でなけりゃ\nお前ら二人纏めて\n舞台から蹴り落としてやる
entries.en: Or I'll kick you\nboth off the stage\nin one go.

entries.jp: ぬぅ……わかったぜよ\nそれで\n次の曲は何だったか
entries.en:
Nngh... all right,
all right. So
what's the next
song again?

entries.jp: オレ様だ\nオレ様の歌で\nてめーらを昇天せてやる
entries.en:
Mine, obviously.
With the great
Takasugi's song,
I'll send you lot
straight to
heaven!

entries.jp: てめーら　オレ様の音を\n一音たりとも聴き逃すなよ\nわかったな？
entries.en:
You lot, don't you
dare miss a single
note of mine. Got
it?

entries.jp: 伸るか反るかの\nこの感覚ッ！\nクールにエンジョイ
entries.en:
This
all-or-nothing
thrill! Stay cool
and ENJOY!

entries.jp: エンジョーーーーーイ！
entries.en: ENJOOOOOOY!

entries.jp: センセー\nシンディは超超\nノリノリだなあ！
entries.en: Sensei, Shindy's\nsuper-duper fired\nup!

entries.jp: ですねぇ
entries.en: Isn't he, though.

entries.jp: シンディの\n歌いたくてたまらない\n気持ちはよくわかるぜよ
entries.en:
I know just how
Shindy feels,
dyin' to sing like
that!

entries.jp: ふふっ　そうですね\nだけど\nそれだけじゃないと思うよ
entries.en: Heh, indeed. But I\ndon't think that's\nall there is to it.

entries.jp: ほえ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 今までの統計から察するに\nもうすぐ邪魔が入る頃だし\n急いでるんじゃないかな
entries.en:
Judging from
past statistics,
someone ought to
interrupt us any
moment now. I
suspect he's
hurrying.

entries.jp: すっと目を細めて\n桂が雷舞屋の扉を見つめる\nその瞬間……
entries.en:
Narrowing his
eyes, Katsura
gazed at the live
house door. At
that very
moment...

entries.jp: 閉ざされていた扉が開き\n新選組の隊士が\n勢いよく雪崩れ込んできた
entries.en:
...the closed door
burst open, and
Shinsengumi
troopers came
pouring in.

entries.jp: 動くな！\n我らは新選組だ！
entries.en: Don't move! We\nare the\nShinsengumi!

entries.jp: そこのトサカくん達は\n僕達の目を盗んで　また\nいけない事をしてたね？
entries.en:
Tosaka-kun and
friends over
there... You
slipped out from
under our noses
to do naughty
things again,
didn't you?

entries.jp: 幕府に楯突く不届き者め\n今度こそ逃がさん！\n覚悟しろ
entries.en:
Insolent
wretches, defying
the shogunate.
You won't escape
this time. Prepare
yourselves.

entries.jp: 土方と沖田の号令の下\n新選組の隊士が\n舞台へ一斉に押し寄せる！
entries.en:
At Hijikata and
Okita's command,
the Shinsengumi
troopers rushed
the stage all at
once!

entries.jp: 予感的中\n今日も邪魔が入りましたね\n龍馬くん　どうします？
entries.en:
Just as I
predicted. We've
been interrupted
again today.
Ryoma-kun, what
shall we do?

entries.jp: 新選組にも聴いて\nもらいたいけどなあ
entries.en:
I'd sure like the
Shinsengumi to
hear us too,
though...

entries.jp: けっ　オレ様の番になると\n邪魔しに来るとは\nそうとう意識してやがるな
entries.en:
Tch. Crashing the
show the second
it's my turn? They
must be real
obsessed with me.

entries.jp: シンディ　センセー\nここは逃げよう
entries.en: Shindy, Sensei,\nlet's make a run\nfor it.

entries.jp: 客を危険な目に巻き込む\nのはいかんからなっ
entries.en: Can't go draggin'\nthe audience into\ndanger!

entries.jp: そうですね\n敵を撹乱するために\n三手に別れて逃げましょう
entries.en:
Agreed. To
confuse the
enemy, let's split
up three ways as
we flee.

entries.jp: 追っ手から逃げ切った後は\n例の場所で落ち合いましょう\n異論はないですね？
entries.en:
Once we've
shaken off our
pursuers, let's
meet at the usual
place. No
objections?

entries.jp: おう！
entries.en: You bet!

entries.jp: ちッ\n仕方ねェな
entries.en: Tch. Fine,\nwhatever.

entries.jp: それじゃみんな　元気でな\nわしらの歌を　また聴きに\n来るぜよォォォオオ
entries.en:
Well then,
everybody, take
care! Come hear
our songs again, I
tell yaaa!

entries.jp: 三人は速やかに結論を出すと\n舞台の裏口へ駆け出した
entries.en:
The three swiftly
reached a
decision and
dashed for the
stage's back door.

entries.jp: それから暫くして……\n龍馬は追っ手を振り切ると\nテラーダに駆け込んだ
entries.en:
Some time later...
Ryoma shook off
his pursuers and
dashed into the
Terada.

entries.jp: 今日の合流場所は\nここだったよな？\nさて　あの二人は……と
entries.en:
Today's meetin'
spot was here,
right? Now,
where are those
two...

entries.jp: 龍馬くん\nこっちですよ
entries.en: Ryoma-kun, over\nhere.

entries.jp: フン\nやっと来たか
entries.en: Hmph. About time\nyou showed.

entries.jp: おお\nセンセーにシンディ
entries.en: Ooh! Sensei and\nShindy!

entries.jp: テラーダの奥座敷で寛ぐ\n桂と高杉に\n龍馬が駆け寄る
entries.en:
Ryoma ran over
to Katsura and
Takasugi, who
were relaxing in
the Terada's back
room.

entries.jp: 二人とも無事だったか！\n良かったぜよ～～
entries.en: You're both safe!\nThank goodness~!

entries.jp: おいバカ　オレ様に\n馴れ馴れしく抱きつくな\n暑苦しいだろう
entries.en:
Hey, idiot, don't
go hugging yours
truly all chummy
like that. You're
stifling me.

entries.jp: 晋作はいけずですねぇ\n龍馬くんが私達との再会を\n喜んでくれているのに
entries.en:
Shinsaku, you're
so mean.
Ryoma-kun is
overjoyed to see
us again, you
know.

entries.jp: オレ様は\nちっとも嬉しくない
entries.en: The great\nTakasugi isn't the\nleast bit glad.

entries.jp: わしは大好きな二人と\n無事会えて嬉しいぜよ！\nセンセーの言った通りだ！
entries.en:
Well, I'm glad I
got to meet up
safe with my two
favorite guys!
Just like Sensei
said!

entries.jp: 龍馬はそう言うと\n高杉と桂を抱き締める腕に\nぎゅっと力を込める
entries.en:
With that, Ryoma
squeezed his
arms even tighter
around Takasugi
and Katsura.

entries.jp:
そうして
再会を喜び合った後
話題は　ごく自然に
先ほどの雷舞に移った
entries.en:
And so, after they
had celebrated
their reunion, the
talk turned quite
naturally to the
live earlier.

entries.jp: 今日の雷舞も\n盛り上がったなあ
entries.en: Today's live got\nreal fired up too,\nhuh!

entries.jp: この前よりも　大勢の\nお客さんが来てたぜよ
entries.en: Even more folks\ncame than last\ntime!

entries.jp: 本物の音楽を欲する心は\nどんな法を作っても\n縛れませんからね
entries.en:
No law they make
can ever bind a
heart that longs
for real music,
after all.

entries.jp: 私達が更に力を磨けば\nより多くの民衆にロックを\n届ける事ができるはず
entries.en:
If we hone our
skills further, we
should be able to
bring rock to even
more people.

entries.jp: くぅぅぅ～～っ\n燃えてきた～～
entries.en: Kuuuuh~! I'm\ngettin' all fired\nup~!

entries.jp: フン\n能天気に騒ぎやがって
entries.en: Hmph. Making a\nracket without a\ncare in the world.

entries.jp: シンディ？
entries.en: Shindy?

entries.jp: 晋作は\nさっきからずっと\n難しい顔をしてますね
entries.en:
Shinsaku, you've
been wearing a
stern look for a
while now.

entries.jp: どうしたんですか\n何か問題でもありますか？
entries.en:
What's the
matter? Is
something
wrong?

entries.jp: どうしたもこうしたもない
entries.en: "What's the\nmatter"? You have\nto ask?

entries.jp: おい　龍馬　桂さん\n今日の雷舞の段取りは何だ
entries.en:
Hey, Ryoma,
Katsura-san.
What was with
the running order
of today's live?

entries.jp: ん？
entries.en: Hm?

entries.jp:
次の曲目に移る前に
何故　客に挨拶を入れた？
理由を聞かせろ
entries.en:
Before moving on
to the next
number, why'd
you stop to talk to
the crowd? Give
me a reason.

entries.jp: そりゃ　みんなに楽しんで\n欲しいからに決まってる\nセンセーもそう思うだろ？
entries.en:
Well, 'cause we
want everybody
to have fun,
obviously! Ain't
that right,
Sensei?

entries.jp: そうですね
entries.en: Indeed.

entries.jp: 私達が声をかけると\nみんな盛り上がって\nくれますから
entries.en:
When we call out
to them, everyone
gets so excited,
after all.

entries.jp: オレ達は噺家じゃねぇ\nロックをやってるんだ\n挨拶なんて無用だ
entries.en:
We're not comic
storytellers. We
play rock. No
need for
chit-chat.

entries.jp: 喋る暇があるなら\n一曲でも多く歌うべきだ\nそうすべきだったんだ
entries.en:
If you've got time
to talk, you
should sing one
more song. That's
what we should've
done.

entries.jp: 晋作は\nあの時に歌えなかったのを\n余程悔やんでるようですね
entries.en:
Shinsaku, it
seems you deeply
regret not getting
to sing back then.

entries.jp: ったりめーだ！
entries.en: Damn straight!

entries.jp: 今まで温めていた\nとっておきの曲が　昨日\nついに完成したんだからな
entries.en:
'Cause the ace
song I've been
savin' up finally
got finished
yesterday!

entries.jp: 新曲が完成したとは\nめでたいですね\n晋作　おめでとう
entries.en:
Your new song is
finished? How
wonderful.
Congratulations,
Shinsaku.

entries.jp: フン\n余計な挨拶さえ無きゃ\n歌えてたのに腹立つぜ
entries.en:
Hmph. If not for
that pointless
chit-chat, I
could've sung it.
Ticks me off.

entries.jp: ぬぅ……\nシンディの気持ちは\nよくわかる　でも
entries.en: Nngh... I get how\nyou feel, Shindy.\nBut...

entries.jp: あのタイミングで\n挨拶を入れたのは……
entries.en: ...the reason we\nput in some talk\nright then...

entries.jp: シンディの\n息が上がってたっていう\n理由もあるから……
entries.en:
...was partly
'cause you were
outta breath,
Shindy...

entries.jp: てめーの見間違えだろう\nオレ様が雷舞中に\nへこたれるわけがねぇ
entries.en:
You must've seen
wrong. As if the
great Takasugi
would run out of
steam in the
middle of a live.

entries.jp: バカのくせに\nオレ様の心配をするなんざ\n百万年早い
entries.en:
An idiot like you,
worrying about
yours truly?
That's a million
years too early.

entries.jp: わしとシンディは同志\n同じ舞台に立つ仲間ぜよ
entries.en:
Shindy, you and
me share the
same cause. We're
friends standin'
on the same
stage!

entries.jp: 大切な\n仲間の心配をするのは\n当たり前のことじゃ
entries.en: Worryin' about a\nprecious friend is\nonly natural.

entries.jp: それに\nわしらは三人で雷舞を\nやってる
entries.en: Besides, the three\nof us are doin'\nthis live together.

entries.jp: 最高の雷舞にするために\nお互いに力を合わせないと\nいかんぜよ
entries.en:
To make it the
best live ever, we
gotta join forces,
y'know!

entries.jp: オレは一人でもやれる\nバカの心配も助けも無用だ
entries.en:
I can do it alone. I
don't need an
idiot's worry or
his help.

entries.jp: シンディ\nそれは違う
entries.en: Shindy, that ain't\nright.

entries.jp: バカの分際で\nオレ様に意見する気か
entries.en:
An idiot like you
thinks he can
lecture the great
Takasugi?

entries.jp: 龍馬と高杉は\n眼光鋭く睨み合い\n互いの意見をぶつける
entries.en:
Ryoma and
Takasugi glared
sharply at each
other, clashing
over their views.

entries.jp: そんな二人を見守る\n桂のもとへ　どこからか\n天狗がやって来た
entries.en:
As Katsura
watched over the
two, the Tengu
showed up from
somewhere.

entries.jp: 賑やかだな
entries.en: My, what a lively\nbunch, eh?

entries.jp:
三人が集まってるって事は
今日も突風雷舞
（ゲリラライブ）を
やってきたのか？
entries.en:
If the three of
you are together,
I take it you
pulled off
another guerrilla
live today, hm?

entries.jp: まったく　嵐山の一件で\nお尋ね者になったのに\nようやるわ
entries.en:
Honestly, lads.
You became
wanted men after
that Arashiyama
business, and still
you keep at it.

entries.jp: おかげで有名にも\nなれましたしねぇ
entries.en: It did make us\nfamous, though.

entries.jp: 幕府に目を\nつけられたけどな
entries.en: Got us on the\nshogunate's\nradar, too.

entries.jp: 音楽の自由を禁じる\n幕府が許せませんし
entries.en:
I can't forgive a
shogunate that
forbids the
freedom of
music...

entries.jp: 私達の歌を\n聴いてもらえるように\nなったんですから
entries.en:
...and now people
are finally
getting to hear
our songs.

entries.jp: 歌いたいと思うのは\n当然の事ですよ？
entries.en: Wanting to sing is\nonly natural,\nwouldn't you say?

entries.jp: いやいやいや\nそりゃあ\nとんでもない決意だろう
entries.en:
No, no, no, lad.
That's one
outrageous
resolve.

entries.jp: このまま雷舞を続け\nもしも幕府に捕まれば\n命の保証はないぞ
entries.en:
Keep up these
lives, and if the
shogunate
catches you,
there's no
guarantee you'll
live, mind.

entries.jp: 怖くはないのか
entries.en: Aren't you afraid,\nhm?

entries.jp: そうですね……\n確かに　自分の身に不安を\n感じる事はあります
entries.en:
Let me see... It's
true I do
sometimes feel
uneasy for my
own safety.

entries.jp: ですがそんなものは\n突風雷舞で味わう興奮と\n喜びに比べたら
entries.en:
But compared
with the
excitement and
joy we taste at a
guerrilla live...

entries.jp: ちっぽけなものです
entries.en: ...such things are\ntrifling.

entries.jp: ロックを奏でる喜びは\n死の恐怖に勝るという事か\n面白い
entries.en:
So the joy of
playing rock beats
the fear of death,
eh? Interesting.

entries.jp: 龍馬や高杉に比べると\n常識人だと思っていたが\n桂も相当ぶっ飛んでいるな
entries.en:
Next to Ryoma
and Takasugi, I
took you for the
sensible one,
Katsura, but
you're pretty far
out there
yourself.

entries.jp: おぬしらを見ていると\n退屈しない　実に愉快だ
entries.en:
Watching you
lads, I'm never
bored. Most
amusing.

entries.jp: これからも精進するといい\nさすれば必ず道は開く\nワシも手を貸そう
entries.en:
Keep honing your
craft, lads. Do
that, and the way
will surely open.
I'll lend a hand,
too.

entries.jp: ではな
entries.en: Farewell, then.

entries.jp: ひらひらと手を振って\n天狗が去ってゆく
entries.en: Waving lightly,\nthe Tengu went\non his way.

entries.jp: また会いましょう\n……って　あの人\n何しに来たんでしょう
entries.en:
Let's meet again...
Wait, what did
that man even
come here for?

entries.jp: まあ　良いか
entries.en: Well, never mind.

entries.jp: 桂は彼を見送ると\n龍馬と高杉に向き直った
entries.en:
Katsura saw him
off, then turned
back to Ryoma
and Takasugi.

entries.jp: さて……そろそろ\n龍馬くんと晋作の仲裁に\n入らないと……
entries.en:
Now then... I'd
better step in
between
Ryoma-kun and
Shinsaku soon...

entries.jp: ……おやおや
entries.en: ...Oh my.

entries.jp: 私が少し目を離した隙に\nまたずいぶん賑やかに\nなってしまいましたね
entries.en:
The moment I
took my eyes off
them, things got
rather lively
again.

entries.jp: この騒ぎを収めるには\n骨が折れそうです\nさあ　どうしましょうか
entries.en:
Settling this
commotion looks
like it'll take some
doing. Now, what
shall I do?

entries.jp: 見なかった事にする
entries.en: Pretend I didn't\nsee it

entries.jp: 発明品で興味を引く
entries.en: Lure them with\nan invention

entries.jp: 歌をうたって場を和ませる
entries.en: Sing to lighten\nthe mood

entries.jp: 今仲裁に入っても\n二人は私の言葉を\n聞きません
entries.en:
Even if I stepped
in now, the two of
them wouldn't
listen to me.

entries.jp: ここは諦めて\n様子を見ましょう
entries.en: I'll give up for\nnow and see how\nthings go.

entries.jp: 桂はしばらくの間\n事態を静観することにした
entries.en: Katsura decided\nto sit back and\nwatch for a while.

entries.jp: 閃きました　私の\n素晴らしい発明品で二人の\n興味を引きましょう！
entries.en:
Inspiration
strikes! I'll catch
their interest
with one of my
marvelous
inventions!

entries.jp: 桂は懐から手の平大の\n金属片を取り出した
entries.en:
Katsura pulled a
palm-sized piece
of metal from the
fold of his
kimono.

entries.jp: これは私が発明した\n超スベールＸ
entries.en:
This is my
invention, the
Super Slipperoo
X.

entries.jp: これを使って鍋を作れば\n油を引かなくても肉や魚が\nくっつきませんっ
entries.en:
Make a pan with
this, and meat
and fish won't
stick, even
without oil!

entries.jp: 調理後のお手入れも超簡単\n水だけで汚れが落ちます！
entries.en:
Cleaning up after
cooking is super
easy, too. The
grime comes right
off with nothing
but water!

entries.jp: 桂は熱心に発明品の\n説明をした
entries.en: Katsura eagerly\nexplained his\ninvention.

entries.jp: 私の歌で　二人の心を\n和ませましょう\n烈　シンギング！
entries.en: I'll soothe their\nhearts with my\nsong. Let's SING!

entries.jp:
桂の癒声
（ヒーリングボイス）が
テラーダに響く
entries.en:
Katsura's healing
voice echoed
through the
Terada...

entries.jp: しかし\n龍馬と高杉の口喧嘩は\n一向に収まらない！
entries.en:
...but Ryoma and
Takasugi's
quarrel showed
no sign of letting
up!

entries.jp: はぁ　困りましたね\n他に良い案は\nないものでしょうか
entries.en:
Sigh... How
troublesome. Isn't
there some other
good idea?

entries.jp: 二人を見て考え込む桂\nそんな彼のもとに\nお登勢が現れた
entries.en:
As Katsura
watched the two,
deep in thought,
Otose appeared
beside him.

entries.jp: 龍ちゃんも晋ちゃんも\nギャーギャー五月蠅いよ
entries.en:
Now, now,
Ryo-chan,
Shin-chan, you're
both squawking
something awful.

entries.jp: 喧嘩はその辺にして\n仲良くピッツァでも食べな
entries.en:
That's enough
fighting, you
boys. Sit down
nicely and have
some pizza.

entries.jp: お登勢は満面の笑みを浮かべ\n超特大の皿を机に置いた
entries.en:
Beaming from ear
to ear, Otose set
an enormous
platter on the
table.

entries.jp: こ　これは超特大ぴっつぁ！\n出来立てのアツアツだっ\n良い匂いがするぜよ
entries.en:
Wh-whoa, a
super-huge
piiizza! Fresh
outta the oven
and piping hot!
Smells mighty
good!

entries.jp: ……ゴクッ\n美味そうじゃねーか
entries.en: ...*Gulp*. Hey, that\nlooks pretty damn\ngood.

entries.jp: シンディ\n雷舞の話は後回しだ\n今はぴっつぁぜよ
entries.en:
Shindy, live talk
can wait. Right
now it's piiizza
time!

entries.jp: チッ　仕方ねェな\nバカと話すより\n黙って飯を食った方がいい
entries.en:
Tch. Fine,
whatever. Beats
talking to an
idiot. I'll shut up
and eat.

entries.jp: はぐはぐはぐ\nもぐもぐ
entries.en: *Munch munch\nmunch* *Chomp\nchomp*

entries.jp: はぐはぐはぐ\nくぅーっ　雷舞の後の飯は\nまた一段と美味い
entries.en:
*Munch munch
munch* Kuuuh!
Grub after a live
tastes even
better!

entries.jp: ……ほっ\nあんなに騒がしかった\n二人が　静かになりました
entries.en:
...Phew. Those two
were so noisy,
and now they've
finally gone
quiet.

entries.jp: お登勢さん\nありがとうございます\nおかげで助かりました
entries.en:
Otose-san, thank
you very much.
You were a great
help.

entries.jp: 礼は要らないよ\nこのくらいお安い御用さ
entries.en:
No need for
thanks, dear.
That was no
trouble at all.

entries.jp: それにしても二人とも\n凄まじい食欲ですね
entries.en:
Still, what
ferocious
appetites they
both have.

entries.jp: 超特大のピッツァが\n恐ろしい勢いで\n消えてゆきます……
entries.en:
That enormous
pizza is vanishing
at a frightening
pace...

entries.jp: ……あの　お登勢さん　\nつかぬことを伺いますが\nよろしいでしょうか
entries.en:
...Um, Otose-san.
Forgive me for
asking out of the
blue, but may I
ask you
something?

entries.jp: 龍馬達がピッツァを頬張る中\n桂はお登勢に耳打ちした
entries.en:
As Ryoma and
Takasugi stuffed
their cheeks with
pizza, Katsura
whispered to
Otose.

entries.jp: 何だい？
entries.en: What is it, dear?

entries.jp: 大食漢の龍馬くんを\n住み込みで雇って\n儲けは出るのですか？
entries.en:
Do you actually
turn a profit,
keeping a big
eater like
Ryoma-kun on as
a live-in worker?

entries.jp: 正直な話\n龍ちゃんの食い扶持だけで\n大赤字の大散財さ
entries.en:
Honestly?
Ryo-chan's food
bill alone has me
deep in the red. It
costs me a
fortune.

entries.jp: だけどね　あの子は\nいいや　あんた達は
entries.en: But you know,\nthat boy... No, you\nboys...

entries.jp: いずれでかい事を\n成し遂げる男さ
entries.en:
...are the kind of
men who'll do
something big
someday.

entries.jp: それを支えるのが\nアタシの役目かなって\n思えてきたのさ
entries.en:
And I've come to
think maybe it's
my job to support
you in that.

entries.jp: お登勢さん……\n何から何まで\nありがとうございます
entries.en: Otose-san...\nThank you for\neverything.

entries.jp: その温かいお気持ちに\nいつか報いたいものです
entries.en:
I hope to repay
your warm
kindness
someday.

entries.jp: じゃあ\n龍ちゃんの代わりに\nお代払ってくれる？
entries.en: Then how about\npaying Ryo-chan's\nbill for him, dear?

entries.jp: さて　冷めないうちに\n私もピッツァを\n頂きましょうか！
entries.en:
Well! I'd best have
some pizza
myself before it
gets cold!

entries.jp: ああん　五郎ちゃん～\nつれないわぁ
entries.en: Ohh, Goro-chan~\nYou're so cold~

entries.jp: テラーダの奥座敷に明るい\n笑い声が響き渡る
entries.en:
Bright laughter
rang through the
Terada's back
room.

entries.jp:
龍馬　高杉　桂は
幕府に追われながらも
民衆の声援を受け
京の町にロックの輪を
広げてゆくのだった
entries.en:
Hunted by the
shogunate but
cheered on by the
people, Ryoma,
Takasugi, and
Katsura spread
the circle of rock
across Kyoto.

entries.jp:
……そして数日後
龍馬達の命懸けの行動は
ついに
実を結ぼうとしていた
entries.en:
...And a few days
later, the efforts
Ryoma and his
friends had
risked their lives
for were finally
about to bear
fruit.

entries.jp: 雷舞屋
entries.en: The live house

entries.jp:
最高雷舞屋
（メジャーライブハウス）
で雷舞……だと？
テンちゃん　本当か？
entries.en:
A live... at a major
live house?
Ten-chan, for
real?

entries.jp: 閑散とした雷舞屋で\n龍馬　高杉　桂は\n目を見開く
entries.en:
In the deserted
live house,
Ryoma, Takasugi,
and Katsura
stared wide-eyed.

entries.jp: 彼等の視線の先には\n静かに頷く天狗がいた
entries.en: Before them\nstood the Tengu,\nquietly nodding.

entries.jp: 本当も　本当だ\n信じられないのなら\nイチから説明してやろう
entries.en:
Real as real can
be, lad. If you
don't believe me,
I'll explain it from
the top.

entries.jp:
おぬしらの人気は鰻登り
もはや小さな雷舞屋では
大勢の贔屓を収めきれない
entries.en:
Your popularity's
shooting through
the roof. Little
live houses can't
hold all your fans
anymore.

entries.jp: え　ええ　仰る通りです\n最近の突風雷舞は常に\n満員御礼の大盛況
entries.en:
Y-yes, quite right.
Our guerrilla
lives lately are
always packed to
the rafters.

entries.jp: 私達の歌声に\n気づくのが遅れた聴衆は\n箱に入れません
entries.en:
Listeners who
notice our singing
too late can't get
into the venue.

entries.jp: いや　入れないどころか\n人だかりのせいで　箱にすら\n簡単に近づけないだろう
entries.en:
Forget getting in.
With those
crowds, they can't
even get near the
venue.

entries.jp: 箱に入る事が出来た奴らも\n押すな押すなの鮨詰め状態
entries.en:
And the ones who
do get in are
packed in like
sardines, shoving
each other.

entries.jp: もっと大きな箱で雷舞をと\n贔屓の奴らに\n何度も言われている
entries.en:
Our fans keep
telling us, over
and over, to play
a live in a bigger
venue.

entries.jp: その話はワシの耳にも\n入っている　……しかし\nおぬしらは幕府のお尋ね者
entries.en:
Word of that has
reached my ears
too. ...But you lads
are wanted by the
shogunate.

entries.jp: 最高雷舞屋に出ようとしても\n箱を使えるとは思えない
entries.en:
Even if you tried
to play a major
live house, I
doubt they'd let
you use the
venue.

entries.jp: だから　ワシが押さえた\nどうだ　でかい箱で\n思う存分暴れてみないか
entries.en:
So I booked one
myself. How
about it, eh? Care
to cut loose all
you like in a big
venue?

entries.jp: みるみるみる\nやるやるやるぜよ
entries.en: I'm in, I'm in, I'm\nin! We'll do it, do\nit, do it!

entries.jp:
最高雷舞屋か　上等だ
天歌でガチガチに固まった
民衆の心（ハート）を
ぶち壊してやる
entries.en:
A major live
house, huh? Bring
it on. I'll smash
the people's
hearts, stiff as
stone from
Heaven's Song!

entries.jp: 私も二人と同じ気持ちです\n天狗さんの提案に\n二つ返事で乗りますよ
entries.en:
I feel the same as
these two. I'll
gladly take you
up on your offer,
Tengu-san.

entries.jp: 三人は天狗の誘いに即答した\n音楽性の違いから頻繁に\n衝突していようとも
entries.en:
The three
answered the
Tengu's invitation
at once. However
often they
clashed over
musical
differences...

entries.jp: ここぞという場面では\n彼等の意見はぴったりと\n一致するのだ
entries.en:
...when it really
counted, their
opinions lined up
perfectly.

entries.jp: それにしても　天狗さん\nどういう風の吹き回し\nですか
entries.en: Still, Tengu-san,\nwhat brought this\non?

entries.jp: 貴方はいつも　私達を\n傍観してるだけだったのに\n雷舞屋を手配するなんて
entries.en:
You've always just
watched us from
the sidelines, and
now you've
arranged a live
house for us?

entries.jp: 本物のロックは\n人の心だけではなく\n天狗の重い腰をも動かす
entries.en:
Real rock moves
more than
people's hearts. It
can even get a
tengu up off his
heavy backside.

entries.jp: ただそれだけの事だ
entries.en: That's all there is\nto it, hm.

entries.jp: はぁ……\nわかるような\nわからないような
entries.en: Er... I sort of\nunderstand, and\nsort of don't.

entries.jp: オレ様の歌の素晴らしさに\nようやく天狗も\n気づいたって事だろう
entries.en:
It just means
even the Tengu
finally noticed
how amazing the
great Takasugi's
songs are.

entries.jp: シンディ　そこは\nオレ様達って言う\nところぜよ
entries.en:
Shindy, that's
where you oughta
say "the great
Takasugi AND
friends"!

entries.jp: うるせぇ
entries.en: Shut up.

entries.jp: それで　テンちゃん\nもっと詳しい話が\n聞きたいぜよ～
entries.en: So, Ten-chan, I\nwanna hear more\ndetails~

entries.jp: テンちゃんが\n押さえたっていう\n雷舞屋はどこじゃ？
entries.en:
Where's this live
house you
booked,
Ten-chan?

entries.jp: この店を出た先にある\n雷舞屋の名は\nイケダヤン
entries.en:
It's just down the
road from here,
lad. The live
house is called...
Ikedayan.

entries.jp: なっ\nイケダヤンですか？\nそれはまた……
entries.en: Wh-- Ikedayan?\nWell, that's...

entries.jp: マジかよ
entries.en: Seriously?

entries.jp: ふむ　流石におぬしらも\nイケダヤンの名を聞いて\n怖気づいているようだな
entries.en:
Hm. Even you
lads seem
daunted, hearing
the name
Ikedayan.

entries.jp: いえ\nそんな事は……
entries.en: N-no, it's nothing\nlike that...

entries.jp: オレ様が\n怖じ気づくなんぞ\nありえねぇが……
entries.en:
The great
Takasugi,
daunted? Not a
chance, but...

entries.jp: センセー　シンディ\nどうしたんじゃ？
entries.en: Sensei, Shindy,\nwhat's the\nmatter?

entries.jp: お前こそ何で首傾げてんだ\nまさかお前　知らないのか\nあの『イケダヤン』を
entries.en:
Why are YOU
tilting your head?
Don't tell me... you
don't know THE
'Ikedayan'?

entries.jp: え～と……センセーは\n知ってるのか？
entries.en: Uh, well... Sensei,\ndo you know it?

entries.jp: 龍馬は桂に\n助けを求める
entries.en: Ryoma looked to\nKatsura for help.

entries.jp: イケダヤンは　京の中で\n人気のある雷舞屋のひとつ
entries.en:
Ikedayan is one
of the most
popular live
houses in Kyoto.

entries.jp: とても大きな施設で\n嵐山の雷舞屋と同等の\n聴衆を収容できます
entries.en:
It's a very large
venue, able to
hold as big an
audience as the
Arashiyama live
house.

entries.jp: 何だとぉぉ　という事は\n新選組の公開雷舞くらい\n人を呼べるのか
entries.en:
Whaaat!? So that
means it can pull
in as many folks
as a Shinsengumi
public live!?

entries.jp: ええ\nそうなりますね
entries.en: Yes, that would\nbe the case.

entries.jp: はぁぁ～～　驚いた\n息が一瞬止まったぜよ
entries.en:
Whew~ What a
shock. My breath
stopped for a
second there!

entries.jp: イケダヤンを\n知らなかったとは\nやっぱりバカはバカだな
entries.en:
Not even knowing
Ikedayan... An
idiot really is an
idiot.

entries.jp: うっ　と　とにかく\nテンちゃんに感謝ぜよ！
entries.en: Ugh-- A-anyway,\nwe owe Ten-chan\nbig!

entries.jp: すごいとこ押さえてくれて\n本当にありがとう！
entries.en:
Thanks a bunch
for bookin' us
such an amazin'
place!

entries.jp: 私も改めて感謝します\nありがとうございます
entries.en:
Allow me to thank
you as well.
Thank you very
much.

entries.jp: 雷舞屋イケダヤン\nオレ様に相応しい舞台だ\n悪くない
entries.en:
The live house
Ikedayan. A stage
worthy of yours
truly. Not bad.

entries.jp: おぬしらの舞台\n期待しているぞ
entries.en: I'll be looking\nforward to your\nshow, lads. Hm.

entries.jp: 天狗は龍馬達としばらく\n話をした後　姿を消した
entries.en:
The Tengu talked
with Ryoma and
the others for a
while, then
vanished.

entries.jp: うぉぉぉぉ\nついに最高雷舞屋か\n燃えてきたぁあああ
entries.en:
Woooooah! A
major live house
at last! I'm gettin'
fired uuuup!

entries.jp:
シンディ　センセー
早速イケダヤンの雷舞に
向けて稽古（リハーサル）を
するぜよ！
entries.en:
Shindy, Sensei,
let's get
rehearsin' for the
Ikedayan live
right away!

entries.jp: 言われなくてもわかってる\n二人とも　今日は夜通し\n付き合えよ
entries.en:
You don't have to
tell me. And you
two are sticking
with me all night
tonight.

entries.jp: 望むところです\n二人が例え音を上げても\n私は止めませんよ
entries.en:
That suits me
fine. Even if you
two cry uncle, I
won't stop.

entries.jp: 龍馬達は大きく頷き合い\n稽古場（スタジオ）へと\n大股で歩いてゆく
entries.en:
Ryoma and the
others nodded
firmly to one
another and
strode off to the
studio.

entries.jp: こうして三人は\n来るイケダヤン雷舞に向けて\n猛練習を始めたのだった
entries.en:
And so the three
began intense
practice for the
coming Ikedayan
live.
